verses.pali: “Amataṁ te, bhikkhave, pamādiṁsu ye kāyagatāsatiṁ pamādiṁsu.
verses.english: “Mendicants, those who have neglected mindfulness of the body have neglected freedom from death.

verses.pali: Amataṁ te, bhikkhave, na pamādiṁsu ye kāyagatāsatiṁ na pamādiṁsu”.
verses.english: Those who have not neglected mindfulness of the body have not neglected freedom from death.”
